title: EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph
mechanism: Add an LLM-free multi-anchor hypergraph memory tier: index raw transcript turns/tool outputs by content-anchor (n-gram/entity overlap), temporal-anchor (session/turn adjacency), and episodic-anchor (thread/episode id), then at recall time do direct hypergraph traversal returning verbatim source spans instead of routing through distillation/summarization before storage

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already has episode/temporal/spreading-activation lanes (recall_spreading, create_episode, RRF hybrid) but distillation is generative-summary-based (field_distill.cpp), so gain would come only from adding a verbatim-evidence-preserving anchor lane, not from novel retrieval structure

cost.scope: chitta/src/handlers/field_memory_recall.cpp, field_distill.cpp, chitta-mcp/server.py recall gateway, storage schema for raw-turn spans

evidence.claim: EdgeMem preserves original interaction turns instead of LLM-generated summaries
multi-anchor hypergraph combines content, temporal, and episodic cues with no generative-LLM calls at construction or retrieval
highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems on LoCoMo (61.01 vs 58.70)
